answer: Price each identity as a trust-graph vertex whose weight comes only from work co-signed by several already-established peers in SEPARATE funding clusters. Each endorsement spends a scarce nectar credit from a peers slowly-refilling pool, so vouches cannot be mass-minted. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet can only whisper endorsements back onto itself, every edge tracing to one root, never spanning distinct clusters, so its vertex stays weightless while a farm pays a fresh cross-cluster anchor per head (linear) versus honest paying once.
